numerical_allowances.monotonicity: Each block/cycle after-before <=value_absolute+value_relative*maxabs(values);record signed changes,never zero-fill them.
numerical_allowances.native_gradient_note: Fixed tiny f* amplifies reconstruction roundoff;this consistency tolerance is separate from first-order thresholds.
numerical_allowances.DF: Original g-corrected kappa and nuclear scalar once;existing sector36 operator norm plus inherited sector_operation_scale_guard8_proposal_v1 <=.00019875 Ha;engineering guard,not rigorous enclosure.
numerical_allowances.first_order_precision: binary64 NumPy/SciPy;JAX x64;no post-result threshold changes
numerical_allowances.coordinate_gradient: Existing gradient_atol1e-8+gradient_rtol1e-7 checks transformed chain rule and independent U residual gradient. Original-coordinate J/U qualification unchanged. Correctness failure stops;no fallback.
numerical_allowances.repair: No numeric allowance changed:gradient1e-8/1e-7,nativeJ1e-6/1e-7,value1e-10/1e-8,first-order1e-5 with original margin,codec1e-10/tensor allowance andDFguard unchanged. Correct comparison points instead of relaxing thresholds.
numerical_allowances.rank_guard: 256*eps64*max(head_map.shape)*max(1,smax);retained quotient/tail singular gap>1024*guard,null singulars<=guard. Numerical qualification,not exact-rank enclosure.

conditions.coefficient_variables: all frames; signed symmetric; no tail preservation equality

initialization_policy: Same original qualified J/U/x0, separate PR/RC2 trajectories. Every trial J solve starts at original J; no saved endpoint warm start. Refinement is a predeclared second subproblem solve, not a retry.

algorithm.outer: SciPy1.14.1 BFGS in U=U0 exp(skew(eta/sqrt2));maxiter64,gtol1e-7,norm2,c1=1e-4,c2=.9,xrtol0. Every unique eta re-solves and refines J; exact-byte cache only. No fixed-J TRF or differentiation through argmin.
algorithm.RC2: Existing augmented gelsd plus one same-objective residual-correction gelsd. Residual accumulates in numpy.longdouble, solves/outputs binary64. Both augmented numeric ranks must be full. Positive alpha gives unique exact inner minimizer.
algorithm.PR: Existing corrected affine Newton-CG,exact analytic Hessian,maxiter1000,xtol1e-12,full-direction SVD metric. One mandatory refinement from first endpoint at same U. No new ridge,gauge constraint,PSD or sign constraint.
algorithm.PR_sufficient_condition: gamma>0,epsilon>0,T tail injective,head A rank LD*d-(LD-1),only nulls are U-independent sum-zero redistributions of c_t*ones(n,n). Check every trial with recorded SVD guards. Extra/ambiguous nulls => REDUCED_GRADIENT_UNQUALIFIED. No pseudoinverse formula at singular HJJ.
algorithm.inner_admission: Refined independent J gradient infinity + old margin <=1e-5; same-point JAX reverse gradient vs forward residual-Jacobian consistency; max(chart,physical) U-gradient change after refinement <=1e-6. 1e-6 is numerical stability allowance,10% physical U threshold; NOT a bound on unknown inner error.
algorithm.qualification_level: NUMERICAL_PILOT_ADMITTED only. Exact envelope requires exact argmin/regularity; empirical refinement stability does not certify derivative error. rigorous_gradient_error_bound=null.
algorithm.acceptance: BFGS line search uses re-solved reduced values. Independently check signed nonincrease at accepted points with original1e-10+1e-8 allowance. Full physical tangent gradient at eta=0 on current U,not chart gradient, decides first-order.
algorithm.limits: 128 distinct trial/initial points per arm;2 J solves per point;256 inner solves per arm;64 accepted BFGS iterations. Same eta cache never hides new solves. No CPU/RAM/wall cap.
algorithm.alternative: Joint local J/eta value-gradient adapter synthetic-tested only;NOT executed by this contract,NOT automatic fallback.
algorithm.coupling_diagnostics: Each trial: initial/refined J and gradients,chart/physical U gradients,refinement shift,structural singular values,accepted-vs-trial labels. No real H4 cross-Hessian sweep in this minimal pilot.

status_policy.first_order: BOTH_FIRST_ORDER_MET only if independent J and physical U gates MET and numerical envelope admission passed
status_policy.correctness: TECHNICAL_FAILURE: source/input/nonfinite/objective/gradient/orthogonality/representation mismatch;preserve partial and stop dependent work
status_policy.trial_stop: Unqualified trial stops arm and is stored;last accepted pair may be exported ONLY as diagnostic endpoint,never an automatic certified fallback. If initial point unqualified,store that computed finite pair as unqualified. The other independent arm may finish within scope.
status_policy.not_comparable: If either first-order/DF/gradient admission fails,qualified_tail_comparison=null. Never rank different raw PR/RC2 objectives.
status_policy.preserve: Do not replay old joint/separated/LP,do not use any old remaining call allowance;old raw/SOURCE/contracts/STOP untouched.
